messages:
jana: Heads-up - billing ops flagged a jump in 'org-unknown' costs this morning. dug in and found sidecar sometimes skips X-Org-Id on proxied requests.
mike: any idea why?
jana: repro in staging when request path /v1/stream goes through edge-rewrite. sidecar logs: 
```
WARN sidecar: auth-exchange failed: timeout=50ms, err=ERR_EXCHANGE_TIMEOUT
route: edge -> sidecar(rewrite)
```
so we never attach org claim and billing attributes end up 'org-unknown'.
kai: current sidecar does single sync exchange with 50ms deadline. tight for multi-hop.
mike: increasing timeout is straightforward but could bump p99. alternative: best-effort local decode + cache. if exchange fails we attribute best-guess and mark confidence low.
jana: I sketched a minimal fallback: (a) look up cached token-hash->org, (b) try local JWT decode to read stable iss/aud claims, (c) if still nothing, set header X-Attribution: unattributed and X-Attribution-Source: fallback_unattributed. No secrets in logs.
edge-proxy-bot: FYI edge team sees ~8ms added when double-proxying auth requests.
kai: two asks: add granular telemetry for failure reasons and add console UI to show attribution source per org so support can triage.
mike: proposed metrics: 
- auth.sidecar.exchange.success
- auth.sidecar.exchange.timeout
- auth.sidecar.exchange.4xx
- auth.sidecar.decode.local_success
- auth.sidecar.attribution.fallback
with tags env, route, org, sampling_bucket.
jana: also add attribution.source in billing events: token_claim | sidecar_local | sidecar_exchange | fallback_unattributed so we can split cost.
kai: rollout idea: enable exchange_retry for 5% canary orgs, monitor fallback rate, then 25% then 100%. flag: feature.sidecar.exchange_retry + canary_orgs list.
mike: console change: add "Attribution Confidence" small pill on per-org usage card, tooltip explaining sources and sample size. avoids support noise.
jana: config prototype: 
```
SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=50
SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=0
FEATURE_SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=2
FEATURE_SIDECAR_CANARY_ORGS=["org-partner-x","org-zen"]
```
I will open a PR to flip the canary flag.
infra-bot: deploy queue: svc-sidecar@canary started by jana (build 5c7a1).
mike: telemetry queries for dashboards: 
- sum:auth.sidecar.exchange.timeout{env:prod} by {route}
- topk(10, sum:auth.sidecar.attribution.fallback{*} by {org})
Also correlate billing delta with fallback tag.
kai: add 1% sampled traces for fallback cases including request_id and token_hash (no token values) so we can replay behavior. sampling controlled by sidecar to avoid perf hit.
jana: logs will include structured line: 
```
info sidecar.attribution {"source":"exchange_timeout","request_id":"r-xxx","token_hash":"h-yyy"}
```
(no token payload).
mike: small policy: do not retry on auth-service 4xx responses (invalid token), only on timeouts/5xx. backoff: linear x2 up to 2 attempts.
kai: good. also ping edge team to explore direct edge->auth calls for hot paths to avoid double proxy latency. tagging them for RFC.
jana: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sidecar/pull/271 - adds retry + fallback + metrics + canary flag. requesting @mike @kai review.
infra-bot: deploy success: svc-sidecar@canary 5c7a1 -> 6/6 healthy
jana: initial 45m canary numbers: exchange.timeout=72 (0.09%), attribution.fallback=18 (0.022%). increasing trace sampling for those ids.
mike: if fallback > 0.5% over 5m trigger slack alert. kai pls add dashboard card and alert.
kai: will add alert: auth.attribution.fallback.rate > 0.5% (5m) for env:prod. also add panel showing attribution.source split.
jana: follow-ups created: ENG-1041 console attribution pill, ENG-1042 billing tag writer, ENG-1043 edge-proxy RFC.
mike: quick nit on PR: include unit test for JWT decode fallback and test that we never log raw token.
kai: + add integration test for 4xx behavior (no retry).
jana: thanks all :thumbsup: monitoring canary and will report back here when billing parity verified.
